text: The milk or cream is homogenised, boiled down under vacuum, filled into cans or bottles and sterilised there, so it keeps without cooling. Figures come from evaporated milk; this product follows the same route at a higher fat.

steps.note: The cream is given stabilisers: disodium phosphate, a salt, which stops it curdling, and carrageenan, a seaweed extract, which stops it settling.
The cream is sterilised in its can or bottle.
